text:
sara: heads up — bumped a new HF checkpoint through the importer and chat responses are randomly dropping words. suspect token id drift from added_tokens insertion :eyes:

matt: can you reproduce locally and paste the tokenizer special tokens + ids?

sara: repro steps quick: ran `hf_to_redwood --model llama2-augmented --out ./redwood-models/llama2-aug` then loaded with our runtime. But before runtime, checked tokenizer from HF and from converted artifacts. here's what I printed:
```
# from HF repo
Special tokens: {'bos_token': '<s>', 'eos_token': '</s>', 'unk_token': '<unk>', 'pad_token': '<pad>'}
IDs: {'<s>': 1, '</s>': 2, '<pad>': 0, '<unk>': 3}

# after conversion (redwood tokenizer.json / added_tokens.json applied)
Special tokens: {'bos_token': '<s>', 'eos_token': '</s>', 'unk_token': '<unk>', 'pad_token': '<pad>'}
IDs: {'<s>': 3, '</s>': 4, '<pad>': 0, '<unk>': 1}
```
sara: note the bos/eos shifted by +2 and unk moved to 1. padding stayed at 0. that explains the garbled sequence boundaries.

jen: ugh, looks like some added_tokens entries are being prepended during import which increments ids. did you have an `added_tokens.json` in the HF repo?

sara: yes — model package included `added_tokens.json` with a couple custom emojis and markers. HF tokenizer merges those into vocab in insertion order. our importer was naively concatenating added_tokens at the front of the vocab instead of appending.

kevin: that would shift all token ids >0. quick mitigation: remap special token ids in the converted vocab using a stable mapping before packaging. also add a unit test that checks bos/eos/unk/pad ids unchanged after conversion.

matt: for clarity, propose a small check in the importer: compute mapping = {hf_id: redwood_id} by token string, assert special token strings map to expected ids or apply mapping override. Pseudocode:
```
# after building redwood_vocab list 
hf_idx = hf_vocab.index('<s>') 
redwood_idx = redwood_vocab.index('<s>') 
if hf_idx != redwood_idx:
    log.warn('special token id shift', token='<s>', hf=hf_idx, rw=redwood_idx)
    apply_remap({'bos_token': redwood_idx})
```

jen: also add end-to-end chat template smoke: run a 5-turn canned convo and assert outputs include expected BOS/EOS markers or stable tokenization lengths. can add to CI under eng-ml/ci/token-stability.

token-audit-bot: automated-scan: detected 2 models in staging with added_tokens inserted-before-vocab pattern. Filing ticket INF-8943.

sara: @jen created a quick PR to importer to append added_tokens instead of prepend + test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/pull/632 :memo:

jen: PR includes a small migration step to backfill existing converted models by checking for common special tokens and remapping if mismatch >0. added unit and integration tests (tokenizer round-trip + chat-smoke). :white_check_mark:

kevin: nice. once merged, we should run a job to reimport the 2 flagged staging models and run the eval suite (latency + generation-quality) to confirm no regression. tagging infra to schedule.

matt: can we also add a lightweight tool to quickly diff special token ids between hf and redwood artifacts? call it `tools/token_id_diff.py`. output should be human readable and machine-parseable for automation.

sara: created a gist with a quick script and sample output: https://gist.github.com/sara/abcd1234 — includes a small sanity-check that will fail the importer if bos/eos/pad/unk remap > 0 without an explicit mapping override.

jen: thanks all. follow-ups: (1) merge PR, (2) run reimport job on flagged models, (3) add token-id-diff job to nightly. anyone blocking?

matt: no blockers from eng-ml. :+1:

kevin: I'll coordinate reimport with infra tomorrow.

sara: closing thread for now, will post results when reimport finishes. :eyes:
